sentences.text: 2 21-06-2023 Heard Mr. Bhola Prasad, learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

The petitioner is in custody since 17.10.2022 in connection with Sadar P.S. Case No. 437 of 2021 for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 342, 366(A), 367, 370, 370(A), 370(5), 371, 372, 373, 376 and 120(B) of the I.P.C. lodged on 28.8.2021 by the informant Anil Kumar Sinha.

As per the prosecution story, the petitioner and the other accused persons are indulged in the prostitution work in which young girls are being forced into the said business and even the daughters of one of the co-accused have made allegation in this regard.
It has been contended by the learned counsel for the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.31112 of 2023(2) dt.21-06-2023 petitioner that only allegation against him is of aiding in flesh trade of Akbar Khaliffa who has since been released on bail by a coordinate bench of this Court in Cr. Misc. No.
28608 of 2022 on 10.11.2022.
Let the same be kept on record.
